public_service_atom.zh: 在零电、断网、无模型状态下，人仍可沿连续无障碍阴影路径穿过一个可交换但不直送噪声的地面层，并在静侧停留。
public_service_atom.en: With power, network and model off, a person can still cross an exchange-capable ground layer on a continuous accessible shaded path without a direct noise path, and can pause on the quiet side.

ablation.B0: authorised read-only paired baseline; no spatial change
ablation.B1: manual professional rule baseline: source-side first, stagger openings, continuous shade, quiet side, accessibility/fire no-harm
ablation.P: explainable passive parameter family: opening position, offset, buffer depth, shade continuity, receiver position and maintenance access
ablation.A: design-time AI Pareto search on frozen authorised/synthetic inputs; no field control
ablation.adoption_gate: AI survives only when stable on held-out/perturbed scenarios, explainable as a drawable spatial consequence, non-dominated relative to B1, and accepted by named professionals.
ablation.deletion_rule: If no stable net gain exists, delete AI and retain B1; no KPI substitution is allowed.
